name: What does 'expired listing relaunch' mean for my home?

mainEntity.name: What does 'expired listing relaunch' mean for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: An expired listing relaunch refers to the process of re-listing your property on the market after its previous listing agreement with another agent or brokerage has ended without a sale. This often involves a fresh strategy, updated marketing, and a review of the home's presentation and pricing. Before relisting, Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution analyzes why the previous listing didn't sell, considering factors like market conditions, property presentation, and pricing strategy, to develop a new approach tailored to the current market in areas like Miami-Dade or Broward County.
acceptedAnswer.description: An expired listing relaunch means re-listing your property on the market after its previous listing agreement ended without a sale, with a new strategy.
